verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents source-available triggers and actions in its public GitHub repo, which accepts PRs for new components, so part of the product's source can be read. A community user notes the workflow engine itself is not open source, and no evidence names an open license. missing for 10: open-source core workflow engine, a named OSI-style open license, independent confirmation of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
You can also create a PR to contribute new components via GitHub.
